name: @metorial/geoapify
description: Geocode addresses, reverse geocode coordinates, and autocomplete addresses. Calculate routes and route matrices across multiple travel modes. Generate and retrieve isolines for reachability analysis. Search places, inspect place details, look up postcodes and boundaries, detect IP geolocation, and match GPS traces to roads. Batch geocode up to 1000 addresses or coordinates, with completed results available as downloadable JSON.
